$comment: Round 32 lane I4 (non-fold oracle-seal proxy) ledger fragment, round19/I2 convention. Merge into liber-primus/LEDGER.json. Instrument measurement, not a key-space sweep; bounded result.
trust_anchor_before: tests/validate.py not run before this lane's work
trust_anchor_after: tests/validate.py ALL VALIDATIONS PASSED (5/5 known solves)

entries.hypothesis: A non-fold, oracle-free proxy (longer decrypt head than the 24-32 runes that capped R20-P1; a per-register fold bar; a learned self-consistency gate; cheap hybrids) can reach >=0.90 catch of correct-key EN_NOVOWEL bar-clearing hallucinations at <=0.10 false-reject of genuine decodes with a tuning/held-out split, holding across the I2 register panel, where the round21/L1 disjoint-fold family topped out at 0.818/0.167.
entries.verdict: SEAL_PASS=false (unchanged) for the pre-registered non-fold designs D1-D4; SEAL_CANDIDATE=D5c (post-hoc per-register pmax margin) passes one virgin split at L=240 but is length-conditioned and unreplicated

gates.threshold: PREREG.md: frozen operating point must score >=0.90 catch and <=0.10 false-reject on tuning AND held-out (L1-comparable) and <=0.10 false-reject on pooled register-spread genuine (strict). Addenda A/B (written before the virgin splits existed) apply the same criteria to D5/D5c on virgin data.

entries.coverage: 391 pre-registered cells: D1 longer-head cut (11 heads x 6 taus), D1b multi-head AND (66), D2 per-register fold bar (7 k x 6 tau_N), fold-family control (42), D3a/D3b learned LR (2 x 50 thresholds), D4 hybrids (54 + 21). Populations: tuning 40 halluc / 20 EN genuine (+5 NOVOWEL genuine); seen held-out 69 / 24 (+64 register-spread genuine); virgin-1 157 / 30 / 17 NOVOWEL / 56 spread; virgin-2 392 / 40 / 33 / 80; L=120 probe 272 / 39 / 92 / 78. Conditionals: key space = correct key; relation = exact preset; register = 8-register panel, EN_NOVOWEL-argmax hallucinations.
entries.control_detail: Single-cut hitfn20 leak reproduced (12/40 tuning, 16/69 held-out caught); L1 fold family reproduces its ceiling (k5/min 0.825/0.050 tuning, 0.855/0.167 held-out, 0.803/0.133 virgin-1, 0.798/0.150 virgin-2); genuine EN_MODERN 20/20 and 24/24 true recovery>=0.95; bar 7.6341931878728095; hard-register genuine planted (correct-key EN_NOVOWEL, LATIN, DE, OE, EN_KJV) and shown to expose the D3 register detectors (13/13 NOVOWEL genuine rejected). Populations are NOT bit-identical to L1 (40/69 vs 45/66) because source corpora differ/are missing.

result.SEAL_PASS_L1_comparable_criterion: D3a/D3b only, via register detection (not a seal)
result.measured_ceiling: best held-out hindsight cell meeting FR_EN<=0.10 AND reg_FR<=0.10 anywhere in D1-D4 = 0.623 catch (D2 k=3 tau_N=0.90); fold family 0.74-0.86; frozen-cell results above

D5c_virgin2_L240.caveat: post-hoc design; NOVOWEL FR Wilson upper 0.153

result.L120_probe: L=240-frozen m_NV rejects 92/92 NOVOWEL genuine at L=120; in-sample refit m~7.3 gives 0.967 catch at FR 0.098 -> margin must be calibrated per length

entries.not_covered: CY/Welsh register (corpus missing; 8-register panel, 4000 null draws); populations not bit-identical to L1 (kjv/mabinogion substituted from analysis/bookcipher/books); wrong-key, keyskip2/drift and non-EN_NOVOWEL hallucination classes (EN_HALFVOWEL hallucinations get no protection from D5c); lengths other than 240 (120 probe only); genuine sets are synthetic corpus windows, small NOVOWEL genuine n; D5/D5c post-hoc and unreplicated; partial-recovery (0.90-0.95) cases excluded.
entries.corpora_sha256: see out_build.json (rebuilt 8-register panel in this lane)
entries.reopens_if: (a) a third virgin key reproduces D5c at >=0.90 catch / <=0.10 pooled FR AND an m_NV(L) curve over >=4 lengths is calibrated -> auto-certification of a crosser can be turned on for the measured class; (b) the Welsh corpus is restored and the 9-register panel changes margins; (c) a wrong-key / keyskip2 / HALFVOWEL hallucination population shows D5c leaks there; (d) a genuine solved-page decode set with lower language fit shows margins below m_NV.
entries.notes: Operative consequence: until the coordinator accepts D5c, bar-clearing survivors stay flagged-for-oracle. Also: L1's EN_MODERN-only genuine panel is passable by a register detector; future seal audits must include hard-register genuine decodes.
